sentence: This project builds an instrument that can analyze proteins in limited cell populations and biopsies in models of aging.
This project studies how cells control the levels of small RNA molecules called microRNAs by regulating how they are made and broken down.
This project studies how the bacterium Treponema pallidum uses its genes during human syphilis infection, using clinical samples.
This project provides human immune profiling for cancer research, using flow cytometry to evaluate patient specimens.
This project studies how the RNA binding protein G3BP1 controls blood vessel formation in embryos.
This project studies how cells respond to nanoscale curvature and biochemical stimuli, using experiments and computational models of cellular signaling and deformation.
This project studies how Factor H Related proteins affect kidney blood vessels when complement causes injury.
This project builds computational models that predict how genetic mutations change protein-protein interactions and gene regulatory networks in disease.
This project studies how primary cilia on lymphatic endothelial cells control the growth of lymphatic vessels.
This project tests a cord blood cell therapy in patients with acute myeloid leukemia and looks for how cancer cells resist treatment.
This project studies how cholinergic signaling differs between male and female mice during prolonged alcohol withdrawal.
This project studies how pathologic tau causes synapse and neuronal network dysfunction in the aging brain.
This project tests a gene therapy made of nanoparticles that delivers a gene to the eye to rescue vision loss in Usher Syndrome Type 2A.
This project tries to find out how ketamine quickly relieves depression by identifying the circuits, cells and molecules involved.
This project studies the genetic basis of how obesity, insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes progress over time in Veterans.
This project builds software and analysis tools for bioinformatics in vision research and eye diseases.
This project tries to find an inhibitor of a virus enzyme that removes ubiquitin from proteins, to treat diseases linked to Epstein-Barr Virus.
This project studies how type H vessels support bone formation in alveolar bone affected by periodontitis.
This project uses large-scale multi-omics data to find how clonal hematopoiesis leads to diseases such as coronary artery disease and stroke.
